subject.title: Skill and Read tools truncating output at ~600-700 chars in 2026.6.11

question: Should maintainers require a packaged v2026.6.11 Linux reproduction before any fix PR, or ask the reporter for raw transcript/config/proposal evidence first?
rationale: The issue describes a serious stable workflow break, but current and shipped source do not show the alleged low cap in the obvious tool paths and Skill Workshop lookup depends on workspace/proposal state.

options.title: Run Packaged Reproduction
options.body: Exercise the reported Linux gateway version with long tool outputs and a Skill Workshop create/update/inspect flow before choosing a code fix.

options.title: Request Reporter Artifacts
options.body: Ask for raw transcript JSONL, config, exact tool calls, channel/provider, proposal id, and workspace paths before further engineering work.

options.title: Track Codex Partial Overlap Separately
options.body: Keep PR #84772 scoped to Codex native transcript caps without treating it as the canonical fix for this multi-tool report.

recommendation.title: Run Packaged Reproduction
recommendation.body: Exercise the reported Linux gateway version with long tool outputs and a Skill Workshop create/update/inspect flow before choosing a code fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history covers read-tool, Skill Workshop, and related projection surfaces, making this the broadest owner signal among the implicated paths.
